An & that would read as a character reference in a link destination or title stays literal

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<a href=\"?&amp;plus;\" title=\"&amp;plus;\">T</a>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
